integrity: All mathematical conclusions are derived within the stated diffusion and reactivity model. The first-reaction framework, Neumann spectral kernel, and classical local-time tools are acknowledged as established background. The attached numerical checks do not certify infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Stationary reflected Brownian diffusion on the unit interval with one reactive endpoint and diffusion coefficient one.
The variance coefficient 2/3 is normalization- and geometry-specific.
Pulse counterexample requires reactivity without a uniform global bound.
The analysis does not establish general-domain or nonstationary-start criteria.
title: A sharp bounded-reactivity criterion and smooth pulse survival in confined Brownian reaction
